title: ArchiveResult status validation broken for string statuses
description: ArchiveResult(status='failed') is accepted without error_message, while ArchiveResult(status='failed', error_message='x') is rejected because checks compare with HandlerStatus by identity. Impact: fail-fast/error reporting contract can silently accept invalid failed results and reject valid failed results when implementers pass strings (which Python dataclasses allow). Fix: __post_init__ coerces str → HandlerStatus via the enum constructor using object.__setattr__ on the frozen dataclass, then enforces invariants by == comparison. Both string and enum status paths produce identical validation. P1.2 of Codex T12+T14a review.
